event.text: Implement the spec, task by task.
I'll start by reading the spec.

1	---
2	feature: File edit diff
3	status: approved
4	---
5	
6	# File edit diff
7	
8	## Goal
9	A user following a session in the chat wants to see what the session did to each file without leaving the transcript. Today every edit is collapsed, so the change is invisible until it is opened. Each file edit — both the one being asked about in a permission card and the one already completed in a tool row — shows its change as a unified diff inline, kept small enough not to swallow the transcript, with a link to the whole edit for when the inline view is not enough.
10	
11	## Behaviour
12	- B1: A completed file edit step in the transcript shows a unified diff of that edit, expanded, without the user opening anything.
13	- B2: A permission card for a file edit shows the same unified diff of the proposed change, in place of the raw tool arguments.
14	- B3: The diff shown in the chat is at most 15 lines. When the full diff is longer, the first 15 lines are shown and the remainder is omitted.
15	- B4: A truncated diff carries a link that states how many lines were omitted and opens the full edit.
16	- B5: Opening the full edit shows the pre-edit content of the file against the file as it currently stands on disk, in the editor's own diff view.
17	- B6: The diff is built from content captured by the extension when the edit tool call starts, not from anything the engine supplies, so it is identical on every engine and is present for edits that were auto-approved without a permission card.
18	- B7: A new file shows as an all-additions diff; an overwrite of an existing file shows as a diff against its prior content.
19	- B8: Each edit gets its own diff. Two edits to the same file in one turn are two diff blocks, each against the file as it stood before that edit.
20	- B9: The file path on the step is clickable and opens the file at the first changed line.
21	- B10: The diff shown in the chat is part of the session's transcript record, so it renders unchanged after a window reload without re-reading the file.
22	- B11: Context around a change is limited to three lines on each side, so the 15-line budget is spent on changed lines.
23	
24	## Edge cases
25	- E1: The user rejects a permission card, or the edit fails → the step shows the outcome and no diff, because nothing changed.
26	- E2: The edit results in no change to the file → the step says so instead of showing an empty diff.
27	- E3: The file is opened in the full-edit view after later edits touched it → the comparison still starts from this edit's pre-edit content, so unrelated later changes appear; this is the intended reading of "the file as it is now".
28	- E4: The file's content cannot be read as text (binary or oversized) → the step reports the change in summary form (path and, where known, lines added and removed) with no diff and no link.
29	- E5: The full diff is 15 lines or fewer → it is shown whole, with no omission notice and no link.
30	
31	## Tasks
32	- T1: Capture pre-edit content at the start of every file edit tool call and carry it on the step's transcript record, surviving reload (B6, B10).
33	- T2: Produce a unified diff from captured content and result, covering new file, overwrite and in-place edit, with three lines of context (B7, B8, B11, E2, E4).
34	- T3: Render the diff inline on completed edit steps and on edit permission cards, with the 15-line cap, the omission notice and its link (B1, B2, B3, B4, E1, E5).
35	- T4: Wire the link and the file path to the editor: full diff view of pre-edit content against the current file, and open-at-first-changed-line (B5, B9, E3).
36	
37	## Open questions
38	- Q1: Should the expanded diff be collapsible again per step, and should that choice be remembered for the session?
39	
40	## Findings
41	
42	| Finding | Proposed solution |
43	|---|---|
44	| F1 (contradiction, B1): every tool step in the transcript is a collapsed `<details>` (`src/chat/webview/chat-transcript.ts`, `ChatTranscript.toolCall`), and the product doc for this feature (`docs/features/edit-diff-view.md`) says a completed Edit/Write row shows the diff *collapsed*. B1 says expanded without the user opening anything. One of the two has to give; if B1 wins, edit rows stop behaving like every other tool row. | Rule for B1 and amend the doc: the feature exists because collapsed edits hide the one thing worth seeing, and the 15-line cap is what removes the doc's reason for collapsing. An edit row deliberately differs from a Read row because the edit is the session's output, not its plumbing. |
45	| F2 (naive, B10/T1): the "transcript record" is the append-only event log `.agent/runs/<id>/events.jsonl` (`src/agent/runs/run-log.ts`, `RunLog.append`), read whole and posted to the webview on every session switch (`SessionManager.transcript`, `ChatViewProvider.sendTranscript`). Carrying the captured pre-edit content on the event means whole file contents are written per edit and re-sent to the webview on each switch. The spec should say the event carries the rendered (capped) diff plus a reference to a pre-edit snapshot stored under the run directory, with the snapshot — not the event — serving B5. | Accept. Reword B10 so the step carries only the capped diff it renders, add a behaviour that the pre-edit content is kept as a snapshot in the session's own run storage that B5 reads, and split T1 into capture-and-store versus carry-the-diff. |
46	| F3 (naive, B8/T2): the spec assumes one edit per tool call. The code already names the editing tools as `Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit` (`src/agent/verify/turn-verifier.ts` `EDITING_TOOLS`, `src/agent/permissions/permission-policy.ts` `FILE_TOOLS`, `src/agent/phases/scope-guard.ts` `preToolUse`), and chat sessions run the Claude engine with no tool restriction (`src/extension.ts` `modeSetup`, only `IMPLEMENT_TOOLS`/plan phases restrict), so a single MultiEdit call carries several edits and NotebookEdit edits a cell inside JSON. The spec should say which tools count as a file edit, whether a MultiEdit step is one diff for the whole call, and that NotebookEdit falls back to the summary form of E4. | Accept. Reword B8 to define a file edit as any step that writes a file, and to say a step carrying several edits to one file shows one diff per edit within that step under a single shared 15-line budget for the whole step, so one step cannot flood the chat; add an edge case putting notebook edits in the summary form of E4 because a cell change is not readable as a text diff. |
47	| F4 (naive, E2): a no-change edit is already an error, not a successful no-op: `src/agent/openai-session/tools/edit.ts` `editTool` fails on `old_string === new_string` and on a missing match, so that path lands in E1. The only successful no-change case is a Write of identical content (`src/agent/openai-session/tools/write.ts` `writeTool`, which writes unconditionally). E2 should name Write-with-identical-content as the case it covers. | Accept. Narrow E2 to a write of content identical to what is already on disk; the unchanged-text and no-match edits are failures and are already covered by E1. |

1	import type { SessionEvent } from '../../agent/session/code-session'
2	import { formatUsage } from './format-usage'
3	import { renderMarkdown } from './markdown'
4	import { PermissionCard } from './permission-card'
5	
6	type AssistantBubble = { element: HTMLElement; text: HTMLElement; thinking: HTMLElement; streamed: string; finalParts: string[] }
7	
8	/**
9	 * The conversation as an append-only stream. Events patch the DOM directly:
10	 * streamed text lands in the bubble it belongs to, tool results attach to
11	 * their call, permission cards resolve in place. `reset()` replays history.
12	 */
13	export class ChatTranscript extends HTMLElement {
14	  private readonly bubbles = new Map<string, AssistantBubble>()
15	  private readonly tools = new Map<string, HTMLDetailsElement>()
16	  private readonly permissions = new Map<string, PermissionCard>()
17	  private readonly runningVerifications = new Map<string, { element: HTMLElement; stop: () => void }>()
18	  private statusLine!: HTMLElement
19	  private busy = false
20	  private working: { element: HTMLElement; stop: () => void } | undefined
21	
22	  connectedCallback(): void {
23	    if (this.childElementCount === 0) {
24	      this.statusLine = document.createElement('p')
25	      this.statusLine.className = 'status'
26	      this.appendChild(this.statusLine)
27	    }
28	  }
29	
30	  reset(events: SessionEvent[]): void {
31	    this.replaceChildren(this.statusLine)
32	    this.bubbles.clear()
33	    this.tools.clear()
34	    this.permissions.clear()
35	    for (const running of this.runningVerifications.values()) running.stop()
36	    this.runningVerifications.clear()
37	    this.working?.stop()
38	    this.working = undefined
39	    this.busy = false
40	    this.setStatus('')
41	    for (const event of events) this.apply(event, false)
42	    // Streamed text is rendered once at the end of a replay, not per delta.
43	    for (const bubble of this.bubbles.values()) {
44	      if (bubble.finalParts.length === 0) renderMarkdown(bubble.streamed, bubble.text, true)
45	    }
46	    this.showWorking()
47	    this.scrollToEnd()
48	  }
49	
50	  apply(event: SessionEvent, live = true): void {
51	    switch (event.type) {
52	      case 'session_started':
53	        this.setStatus(`${event.model} · Claude Code ${event.engineVersion ?? ''}`.trim())
54	        break
55	      case 'user_message':
56	        this.insert(block('user', event.text))
57	        this.busy = true
58	        break
59	      case 'assistant_text': {
60	        const bubble = this.bubble(event.messageId, event.parentToolUseId)
61	        bubble.streamed += event.delta
62	        if (live && bubble.finalParts.length === 0) renderMarkdown(bubble.streamed, bubble.text, false)
63	        break
64	      }
65	      case 'assistant_thinking': {
66	        const bubble = this.bubble(event.messageId, event.parentToolUseId)
67	        bubble.thinking.hidden = false
68	        bubble.thinking.textContent += event.delta
69	        break
70	      }
71	      case 'assistant_message': {
72	        const bubble = this.bubble(event.messageId, event.parentToolUseId)
73	        bubble.finalParts.push(event.text)
74	        renderMarkdown(bubble.finalParts.join(''), bubble.text, true)
75	        break
76	      }
77	      case 'tool_call':
78	        this.insert(this.toolCall(event), event.parentToolUseId)
79	        break
80	      case 'tool_result': {
81	        const details = this.tools.get(event.toolUseId)
82	        const result = document.createElement('pre')
83	        result.className = event.isError ? 'result error' : 'result'
84	        result.textContent = event.text
85	        if (details) {
86	          details.appendChild(result)
87	          details.classList.toggle('failed', event.isError)
88	        } else {
89	          this.insert(result, event.parentToolUseId)
90	        }
91	        break
92	      }
93	      case 'permission_request': {
94	        const card = new PermissionCard()
95	        card.className = 'permission'
96	        this.insert(card)
97	        card.show(event)
98	        this.permissions.set(event.requestId, card)
99	        // The card is the indicator now; a ticking clock would say the model is at work.
100	        this.busy = false
101	        break
102	      }
103	      case 'permission_resolved':
104	        this.permissions.get(event.requestId)?.resolve(event.decision)
105	        this.busy = true
106	        break
107	      case 'status':
108	        // 'idle' also arrives mid-turn (after compaction, between requests); only the turn's end clears busy.
109	        if (event.status !== 'idle') this.busy = true
110	        this.classList.toggle('verifying', event.status === 'verifying')
111	        break
112	      case 'verification_started': {
113	        const row = document.createElement('p')
114	        row.className = 'verification running'
115	        const key = `${event.cwd}::${event.command}`
116	        const startedAt = Date.now()
117	        row.textContent = `Running: ${event.command}`
118	        const timer = live
119	          ? window.setInterval(() => {
120	              row.textContent = `Running: ${event.command} (${Math.round((Date.now() - startedAt) / 1000)}s)`
121	            }, 1000)
122	          : undefined
123	        this.runningVerifications.get(key)?.element.remove()
124	        this.runningVerifications.set(key, {
125	          element: row,
126	          stop: () => {
127	            if (timer !== undefined) window.clearInterval(timer)
128	          },
129	        })
130	        this.insert(row)
131	        break
132	      }
133	      case 'verification': {
134	        const key = `${event.cwd}::${event.command}`
135	        const running = this.runningVerifications.get(key)
136	        this.runningVerifications.delete(key)
137	        running?.stop()
138	        const details = document.createElement('details')
139	        details.className = event.ok ? 'verification ok' : 'verification failed'
140	        const summary = document.createElement('summary')
141	        summary.textContent = `${event.ok ? 'Verified' : 'Verification failed'}: ${event.command}`
142	        const out = document.createElement('pre')
143	        out.className = 'result'
144	        out.textContent = event.output || '(no output)'
145	        details.append(summary, out)
146	        if (running) running.element.replaceWith(details)
147	        else this.insert(details)
148	        break
149	      }
150	      case 'turn_done': {
151	        this.busy = false
152	        this.classList.remove('verifying')
153	        const line = document.createElement('p')
154	        line.className = event.isError ? 'turn error' : 'turn'
155	        const usage = event.usage
156	        const parts = []
157	        if (usage) parts.push(formatUsage(usage))
158	        if (usage?.costUsd) parts.push(`$${usage.costUsd.toFixed(4)}`)
159	        if (event.durationMs) parts.push(`${(event.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`)
160	        if (event.errors.length) parts.push(event.errors.join('; '))
161	        line.textContent = parts.join(' · ')
162	        this.insert(line)
163	        break
164	      }
165	      case 'error':
166	        this.insert(block(event.fatal ? 'error fatal' : 'error', event.message))
167	        if (event.fatal) this.busy = false
168	        break
169	      case 'ended':
170	        this.busy = false
171	        this.insert(block('ended', 'Engine stopped. The next prompt resumes the conversation.'))
172	        break
173	    }
174	    if (live) {
175	      this.showWorking()
176	      this.scrollToEnd()
177	    }
178	  }
179	
180	  /** A pulsing "Working…" row with elapsed time, kept last, while the model is at work. */
181	  private showWorking(): void {
182	    if (!this.busy) {
183	      this.working?.stop()
184	      this.working?.element.remove()
185	      this.working = undefined
186	      return
187	    }
188	    if (!this.working) {
189	      const row = document.createElement('p')
190	      row.className = 'working'
191	      row.textContent = 'Working…'
192	      const startedAt = Date.now()
193	      const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
194	        row.textContent = `Working… ${Math.round((Date.now() - startedAt) / 1000)}s`
195	      }, 1000)
196	      this.working = { element: row, stop: () => window.clearInterval(timer) }
197	    }
198	    this.appendChild(this.working.element)
199	  }
200	
201	  private bubble(messageId: string, parentToolUseId: string | undefined): AssistantBubble {
202	    const existing = this.bubbles.get(messageId)
203	    if (existing) return existing
204	    const element = document.createElement('article')
205	    element.className = 'assistant'
206	    const thinking = document.createElement('pre')
207	    thinking.className = 'thinking'
208	    thinking.hidden = true
209	    const text = document.createElement('div')
210	    text.className = 'text'
211	    element.append(thinking, text)
212	    this.insert(element, parentToolUseId)
213	    const bubble = { element, text, thinking, streamed: '', finalParts: [] }
214	    this.bubbles.set(messageId, bubble)
215	    return bubble
216	  }
217	
218	  private toolCall(event: Extract<SessionEvent, { type: 'tool_call' }>): HTMLDetailsElement {
219	    const details = document.createElement('details')
220	    details.className = 'tool'
221	    const summary = document.createElement('summary')
222	    summary.textContent = `${event.name} ${summarizeInput(event.input)}`
223	    const input = document.createElement('pre')
224	    input.className = 'input'
225	    input.textContent = JSON.stringify(event.input, null, 2)
226	    details.append(summary, input)
227	    this.tools.set(event.toolUseId, details)
228	    return details
229	  }
230	
231	  /** Subagent output nests under the tool call that spawned it. */
232	  private insert(element: HTMLElement, parentToolUseId?: string): void {
233	    const parent = parentToolUseId ? this.tools.get(parentToolUseId) : undefined
234	    ;(parent ?? this).appendChild(element)
235	  }
236	
237	  private setStatus(text: string): void {
238	    this.statusLine.textContent = text
239	    this.statusLine.hidden = text === ''
240	  }
241	
242	  private scrollToEnd(): void {
243	    this.scrollTop = this.scrollHeight
244	  }
245	}
246	
247	function block(className: string, text: string): HTMLElement {
248	  const element = document.createElement('article')
249	  element.className = className
250	  element.textContent = text
251	  return element
252	}
253	
254	function summarizeInput(input: unknown): string {
255	  if (typeof input !== 'object' || input === null) return ''
256	  const record = input as Record<string, unknown>
257	  const key = ['command', 'file_path', 'pattern', 'path', 'query', 'description'].find((k) => typeof record[k] === 'string')
258	  if (!key) return ''
259	  const value = record[key] as string
260	  return value.length > 80 ? value.slice(0, 77) + '...' : value
261	}
262	
263	customElements.define('chat-transcript', ChatTranscript)

1	import type { CodeSession, PermissionDecision, SessionEvent } from './code-session'
2	import type { ModelProfile } from './model-profile'
3	import type { RunLog } from '../runs/run-log'
4	
5	/**
6	 * `plan` writes a feature's spec blind, `reconcile` checks it against the code
7	 * (together: planning), `implement` builds the approved spec.
8	 */
9	export type SessionMode = 'chat' | 'plan' | 'reconcile' | 'implement'
10	
11	export const isPlanning = (mode: SessionMode): boolean => mode === 'plan' || mode === 'reconcile'
12	
13	export type SessionRecord = {
14	  id: string
15	  title: string
16	  profile: ModelProfile
17	  mode: SessionMode
18	  /** The feature whose spec the session works on; every mode but chat. */
19	  feature?: string
20	  /** The session whose tab this one runs under: a check runs under its plan session and never gets a tab of its own. */
21	  parentId?: string
22	  /** Engine-side conversation id, set once the engine reports it. Lets a closed session continue. */
23	  engineSessionId?: string
24	  createdAt: string
25	}
26	
27	export interface SessionStore {
28	  list(): SessionRecord[]
29	  save(records: SessionRecord[]): Promise<void>
30	}
31	
32	function titleFor(mode: SessionMode, feature: string | undefined): string {
33	  if (!feature) return 'New session'
34	  switch (mode) {
35	    case 'plan':
36	      return `Plan: ${feature}`
37	    case 'reconcile':
38	      return `Check: ${feature}`
39	    case 'implement':
40	      return `Implement: ${feature}`
41	    case 'chat':
42	      return 'New session'
43	  }
44	}
45	
46	export type EngineFactory = (record: SessionRecord) => Promise<CodeSession>
47	
48	export type SessionListener = (sessionId: string, event: SessionEvent) => void
49	
50	/**
51	 * Owns the list of sessions and the live engines behind them. A session is
52	 * started lazily on its first prompt, and continued from its engine session
53	 * id after the extension host restarted.
54	 */
55	export class SessionManager {
56	  private records: SessionRecord[]
57	  private readonly live = new Map<string, CodeSession>()
58	  /** Per session, the call the user allowed after its engine had stopped; answered for them when the resumed engine asks. */
59	  private readonly preapproved = new Map<string, { toolName: string; input: string }>()
60	
61	  constructor(
62	    private readonly store: SessionStore,
63	    private readonly createEngine: EngineFactory,
64	    private readonly runLogFor: (sessionId: string) => RunLog,
65	    private readonly listener: SessionListener,
66	  ) {
67	    // Records written before modes existed are chat sessions.
68	    this.records = store.list().map((r) => ({ ...r, mode: r.mode ?? 'chat' }))
69	  }
70	
71	  list(): SessionRecord[] {
72	    return [...this.records]
73	  }
74	
75	  get(id: string): SessionRecord | undefined {
76	    return this.records.find((r) => r.id === id)
77	  }
78	
79	  isLive(id: string): boolean {
80	    return this.live.has(id)
81	  }
82	
83	  /** The live session running under another one's tab, if any. */
84	  liveChildOf(parentId: string): SessionRecord | undefined {
85	    return this.records.find((r) => r.parentId === parentId && this.live.has(r.id))
86	  }
87	
88	  async create(profile: ModelProfile, mode: SessionMode = 'chat', feature?: string, parentId?: string): Promise<SessionRecord> {
89	    const record: SessionRecord = {
90	      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
91	      title: titleFor(mode, feature),
92	      profile,
93	      mode,
94	      ...(feature ? { feature } : {}),
95	      ...(parentId ? { parentId } : {}),
96	      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
97	    }
98	    this.records.unshift(record)
99	    await this.store.save(this.records)
100	    return record
101	  }
102	
103	  async send(id: string, text: string): Promise<void> {
104	    const record = this.require(id)
105	    if (record.title === 'New session') {
106	      record.title = text.length > 60 ? text.slice(0, 57) + '...' : text
107	      await this.store.save(this.records)
108	    }
109	    ;(await this.ensureLive(record)).send(text)
110	  }
111	
112	  /**
113	   * A request the engine still holds is answered in place. One the engine let
114	   * go of (it stopped with the prompt open, say over a window reload) resumes
115	   * the session: the decision becomes the next user turn, and an allow is
116	   * honoured once more should the resumed engine ask for the same call again.
117	   */
118	  async respondToPermission(id: string, requestId: string, decision: PermissionDecision): Promise<void> {
119	    const live = this.live.get(id)
120	    if (live) {
121	      live.respondToPermission(requestId, decision)
122	      return
123	    }
124	    const record = this.require(id)
125	    const request = await this.openRequest(record, requestId)
126	    if (!request) throw new Error(`Permission request ${requestId} is no longer open`)
127	    await this.emit(record, { type: 'permission_resolved', requestId, decision: decision.kind })
128	    if (decision.kind === 'allow') this.preapproved.set(id, { toolName: request.toolName, input: JSON.stringify(request.input) })
129	    await this.send(id, decisionPrompt(request, decision))
130	  }
131	
132	  async interrupt(id: string): Promise<void> {
133	    await this.live.get(id)?.interrupt()
134	  }
135	
136	  /** Stop the engine but keep the record; a later prompt resumes it. A run under the session stops with it. */
137	  async close(id: string): Promise<void> {
138	    for (const child of this.records.filter((r) => r.parentId === id)) await this.close(child.id)
139	    const session = this.live.get(id)
140	    if (!session) return
141	    this.live.delete(id)
142	    await session.dispose()
143	  }

226	/** The decision as the model hears it once the engine that asked is gone: the call is named in full so nothing rests on what the resumed engine remembers. */
227	export function decisionPrompt(request: PermissionRequest, decision: PermissionDecision): string {
228	  const call = `the \`${request.toolName}\` call you proposed`
229	  const input = `\`\`\`json\n${JSON.stringify(request.input, null, 2)}\n\`\`\``

270	      }
271	      case 'interrupt':
272	        if (this.activeSessionId) await this.sessions.interrupt(this.activeSessionId)
273	        return
274	      case 'set_verify':
275	        if (this.activeSessionId) this.verify.setEnabled(this.activeSessionId, message.enabled)
276	        void this.sendState()
277	        return
278	      case 'switch_session':
279	        await this.open(message.sessionId)
280	        return
281	      case 'close_session':

283	        return
284	      case 'new_session':

286	        return
287	      case 'resume_plan':

299	      }

306	      case 'edit_comment':

308	        return
309	      case 'remove_comment':
310	        await this.reviewing((review) => removeComment(review, message.commentId))
311	        return
312	      case 'strike_item':
313	        await this.reviewing((review) => strikeItem(review, message.itemId))
314	        return
315	      case 'unstrike_item':
316	        await this.reviewing((review) => unstrikeItem(review, message.itemId))
317	        return
318	      case 'accept_resolution':
319	        // Accepting a resolution, including a disagreement, is the human's own act; it needs no draft.
320	        await this.reviewing((review) => acceptResolution(review, message.commentId), false)
321	        return
322	      case 'submit_review': {
323	        const record = this.activeRecord()
324	        if (!record?.feature) return
325	        await submitReview({
326	          courier: this.courier(),
327	          cwd: this.workspaceRoot,
328	          feature: record.feature,
329	          owner: { sessionId: record.id },
330	        })
331	        await this.sendState()
332	        return
333	      }
334	      case 'check_spec': {
335	        const record = this.activeRecord()
336	        if (record?.mode !== 'plan' || !record.feature || this.sessions.liveChildOf(record.id)) return
337	        const child = await this.sessions.create(this.profileFor('reconcile'), 'reconcile', record.feature, record.id)
338	        this.checks.set(record.id, { live: true, text: 'Checking the spec against the code…' })
339	        await this.sendState()
340	        await this.sessions.send(child.id, RECONCILE_KICKOFF)
341	        return
342	      }
343	      case 'stop_check': {
344	        const record = this.activeRecord()
345	        const child = record ? this.sessions.liveChildOf(record.id) : undefined
346	        if (!record || !child) return
347	        this.checks.set(record.id, { live: false, text: 'Check stopped' })
348	        await this.sessions.close(child.id)
349	        await this.sendState()
350	        this.changed.fire()
351	        return
352	      }
353	      case 'implement_spec': {
354	        const record = this.activeRecord()
355	        const path = this.activeSpecPath()
356	        if (record?.mode !== 'plan' || !record.feature || !path) return
357	        assertImplementable(await readSpecState(path))
358	        await this.newSession('implement', record.feature, IMPLEMENT_KICKOFF)
359	        return
360	      }
361	      case 'update_intent': {
362	        const feature = this.activeRecord()?.feature
363	        const path = this.activeSpecPath()
364	        if (!feature || !path) return
365	        assertAmendable(await readSpecState(path))

6	const schema = z.object({
7	  file_path: z.string().describe('Path to the file, absolute or relative to the working directory'),
8	  old_string: z.string().describe('Exact text to replace; must occur once unless replace_all is set'),
9	  new_string: z.string().describe('Replacement text'),
10	  replace_all: z.boolean().optional().describe('Replace every occurrence'),
11	})

13	export const editTool: Tool<typeof schema> = {
14	  name: 'Edit',
15	  description:
16	    'Replaces exact text in a file that has been read in this session. old_string must match exactly, including indentation, and must be unique unless replace_all is true.',
17	  schema,
18	  readOnly: false,
19	  async execute(input, ctx) {
20	    const path = isAbsolute(input.file_path) ? input.file_path : resolve(ctx.cwd, input.file_path)
21	    const reason = await ctx.files.staleness(path)
22	    if (reason) return fail(reason)
23	    if (input.old_string === input.new_string) return fail('old_string and new_string are identical')
24	    const content = await readFile(path, 'utf8')
25	    const occurrences = count(content, input.old_string)
26	    if (occurrences === 0) return fail(`old_string not found in ${path}`)
27	    if (occurrences > 1 && !input.replace_all) {
28	      return fail(`old_string occurs ${occurrences} times in ${path}; add more context or set replace_all`)
29	    }
30	    const updated = input.replace_all
31	      ? content.split(input.old_string).join(input.new_string)
32	      : content.replace(input.old_string, () => input.new_string)
33	    await writeFile(path, updated, 'utf8')
34	    await ctx.files.markRead(path)
35	    return ok(`Edited ${path} (${occurrences} replacement${occurrences === 1 ? '' : 's'})`)
36	  },
37	}

39	function count(haystack: string, needle: string): number {
40	  if (needle === '') return 0
41	  let n = 0
42	  let i = haystack.indexOf(needle)
43	  while (i !== -1) {
44	    n++
45	    i = haystack.indexOf(needle, i + needle.length)
46	  }
47	  return n
48	}

92	export function capDiffs(diffs: string[][], budget: number): { diffs: string[][]; omitted: number } {
93	  const total = diffs.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.length, 0)
94	  if (total <= budget) return { diffs, omitted: 0 }
95	  const kept: string[][] = []
96	  let spent = 0
97	  for (const diff of diffs) {
98	    if (spent >= budget) break
99	    const room = budget - spent
100	    kept.push(diff.slice(0, room))
101	    spent += Math.min(room, diff.length)
102	  }
103	  return { diffs: kept, omitted: total - spent }
